description: This file defines the ShortcutSetStorage class for managing shortcut set entities in Drupal, including user assignment, retrieval, and default set logic.

classes.name: ShortcutSetStorage
classes.description: A storage class for managing shortcut set entities, including user assignment and default set logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with dependencies such as entity info, config factory, UUID service, module handler, language manager, memory cache, and database connection.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ShortcutSetStorage with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: deleteAssignedShortcutSets
methods.description: Deletes user assignments for a given shortcut set entity.

methods.name: assignUser
methods.description: Assigns a shortcut set to a user and invalidates the user's cache tags.

methods.name: unassignUser
methods.description: Removes a shortcut set assignment from a user and invalidates cache tags.

methods.name: getAssignedToUser
methods.description: Retrieves the shortcut set assigned to a user.

methods.name: getDisplayedToUser
methods.description: Returns the shortcut set displayed to a user, either assigned or default.

methods.name: countAssignedUsers
methods.description: Counts the number of users assigned to a specific shortcut set.

methods.name: getDefaultSet
methods.description: Determines the default shortcut set for a user, considering module suggestions and fallback.
